results.title: CAN I COME HOME NOW?
results.overview: A quiet stroll through the heart of Paris, where solitude and memories are imbued with a unique melancholy.

results.title: Plankgas
results.overview: After taking a detour on a deserted road, a professional entertainer is pursued by a menacing pick-up truck and must outsmart its relentless driver to survive.

results.title: Magi: A Story of Wonder
results.overview: What if the Star of Bethlehem wasn't a myth? Join Andy Reese on a fascinating journey through history, astronomy, geography, and Scripture to uncover the remarkable evidence behind the story of the Magi and discover the wonder of a God who is always at work.

results.title: A Richer Christmas
results.overview: When a wealthy family loses everything before the holidays, their world falls apart — but in the chaos, they discover the true meaning of Christmas.

results.title: Fabrica
results.overview: A collection of portraits from Drobeta-Turnu Severin and its surroundings.

results.title: One-Off
results.overview: When a death row convicted taxi driver picks his final meal, a twisted cook is determined to make it his most memorable.

results.title: Teen Spirits
results.overview: In a deserted high school, a group of teenagers gathers for a mysterious choral ritual.

results.title: Wrapped in Christmas Memories
results.overview: Seeking a buyer for her family’s antique store this Christmas, tech guru Delphia butts heads with history buff Keenan, who wants to buy it. But when she discovers a mystery in the store’s famous Christmas Dollhouse, he’s the only one who can help her solve it.

results.title: Pioneers
results.overview: Pioneers, Written and Directed by Cooper Shelton, follows four young boys who venture down into ancient underground city, with one goal. Find an ancient giant that supposedly terrorized the civilization that dominated the depths a millennium ago.

results.title: Maria Merciful Mind
results.overview: A woman tormented by trauma, anxiety, and a fractured sense of reality reaches her breaking point until a life-changing confession forces her to confront her past, setting her on a powerful journey toward faith, healing, and redemption.

results.title: while I was away
results.overview: ‘while I was away' follows a group of four friends spending an ordinary day together, but beneath the laughter and nostalgia, one of them feels increasingly disconnected. As the day unfolds, memories and dreamlike moments blur the line between being surrounded by people and truly feeling present. A short film about friendship, isolation and the quiet distance we can feel, even when we're never physically alone.

results.title: Tendu Pointe Battement
results.overview: A celebration of dance, music, movement, language, and animation.

results.title: My New Form
results.overview: Bob, a young conspiracy theorist, is convinced that a powerful corporation is using young men as unwitting tools in a global surveillance system. When his worst nightmare suddenly becomes reality, he flees into an absurd world where the line between paranoia and reality begins to blur.

results.title: On the Wings of Time
results.overview: Two college graduates grapple the progression of time.

results.title: Silver
results.overview: To help the girl he likes, a boy tries to sell his grandmother's silver necklace, only to be swindled by an evil dealer.

results.title: Scorcher
results.overview: Elaine, a young crowd canvasser, struggles to raise money for women’s reproductive healthcare on the hottest day of the summer. She’s on the brink of being fired and showing signs of heat exhaustion when a coworker approaches her about starting a canvassing union.

results.title: The Malthus Law
results.overview: In an attempt to address overpopulation, TV host Olivia is selected by an AI that compels people to defend their right to life, leading to conflicts over the value and malleability of life between her and the other selected individuals.
